scope: Template detail like submissions, late metadata reconciliation, route disposal and confirmed local persistence

observed_before: Two immediate button callbacks caused two account resolutions and duplicate server toggles.
Closing during delayed account resolution produced setState() called after dispose().
change: Acquire the submission lock before hydration/account lookup.
Use an outer try/finally so errors and early returns release the lock.
Stop unsubmitted work after disposal and suppress further UI/follow-up work after an already-submitted action completes.

observed_before: The first reconciliation changed the latest unlike selection back to liked.
Late initial metadata also reset a newer like to unliked.
change: An operation revision rejects older toggle reconciliation after a newer interaction.
A separate scalar like-state revision preserves newer optimistic, rollback and confirmed state across metadata reads and asynchronous document preparation.
Persist immutable snapshots rather than reading mutable widget state after awaits.

findings.observed_before: A reconciliation completed after account-a changed to account-b and replaced account-a stored {isLiked:true,likeCount:2} with {isLiked:false,likeCount:8}.
change: Use the existing optional TemplateSessionSource current owner instead of stale secure storage for account-aware repositories.
Check the captured repository/owner at async completion before applying fetched metadata, UI changes and follow-up invalidations.
Do not add an auth subscription or polling. Legacy repositories and offline published favorites retain their fallback.

findings.observed_before: With a controlled pending preferences write, server submissions remained zero. Closing at that point could leave a locally liked record without sending the toggle.
change: Start the server action after account resolution/optimistic UI, before waiting on local preferences.
Save the captured confirmed intent/account after server success even if its route has closed, then gate all UI and reconciliation on the live operation.
Remove the redundant identical post-success local write. A failed server toggle rolls back the view and persists the previous state while the operation is still current.

test_fixture_follow_up.cause: The edition navigation test provided an empty product catalog. The current native action correctly disables an unlisted paid product, so no edition sheet was created.
test_fixture_follow_up.baseline_control: The identical No element failure was reproduced using the pre-change production source snapshot in output/baseline; no shared source was swapped or reverted.
test_fixture_follow_up.change: Supply one active, priced product in this test fixture using the existing stable template product key. The denied purchase gate remains in place, preserving the detail after previewing editions.

checked: Repeated callbacks, account lookup error/retry, API failure/rollback/retry, early close, late POST completion and close/reopen.
Older reconciliation and initial hydration cannot replace newer selection or its persisted snapshot.
Confirmed actions persist under the captured owner; close/account change does not start a new reconciliation.
Related edition navigation, gallery tabs/thumbnail movement, large text/dark mode, artwork lifetime, document preparation, purchase keys and store request-sharing regressions pass.
Only scalar revisions and operation-local guards were added. No cache/history, per-frame work, image decoding, new document generation or subscription was added.
The previous preferences write queue is preserved; each operation snapshots its intent and the successful toggle no longer writes that identical intent twice.
review.shared_workspace: Preserved all pre-existing modifications. Only the listed production file and test files were edited; baseline evidence uses isolated copies with normalized imports.

next_candidates: Detail metadata reads currently use the full catalog even after a valid server toggle; review a single-record reconciliation without breaking legacy title matching.

Review idle detail account changes, same-account re-login and rapid account-a/account-b/account-a transitions separately; this run covers owner mismatch at async boundaries, not every session transition.
Resume main album/reader hidden-resume photo preparation and failure recovery after checking concurrent work and newer verification records.

limits: An already-started server request is not physically cancelled; closed or superseded views ignore its metadata and avoid subsequent UI/reads. Confirmed user mutations can finish their captured local save.
Owner guards use the existing repository identity interface. They do not replace server authorization or add session event monitoring for idle details.
Real device frame timing, native memory, network throughput and customer storage were not measured. No blanket claim of zero lag or zero memory leaks is made.
